gwt.given: WriteField is called for a ShardKey<int> value for which ReferenceCodec.TryWriteReferenceField(ref writer, fieldIdDelta, expectedType, value) returns true, and separately ReadValue is called for a field whose WireType already equals WireType.Reference
gwt.when: ShardKeyOrleansSerializer<int> executes WriteField for the first case and ReadValue for the second
gwt.then: WriteField returns immediately after TryWriteReferenceField without writing a field header, a length, or key bytes for that occurrence; ReadValue takes the WireType.Reference branch and returns the value produced by ReferenceCodec.ReadReference<ShardKey<int>, TInput> without calling EnsureWireType, ReadVarUInt32, or ReadBytes
